open_order_cap.title: Open orders per customer (0 = no cap)
open_order_cap.description: Orders in an `open` status of the lifecycle count; pay-on-delivery orders waiting for confirmation count too.

cap_action.title: Over the cap
cap_action.description: review (accept and queue for manual review) or reject (refuse the order at intake).

cod_max_total.title: Largest pay-on-delivery total, per currency (minor units)

cod_advance_percent.title: Pay-on-delivery advance (% of the total)
cod_advance_percent.description: Collected before the order is confirmed; a flat amount below wins when set for the order's currency.

cod_advance_amount.title: Pay-on-delivery advance, flat, per currency (minor units)

rto_reasons.title: Return reasons that count as return-to-origin

rto_warning_threshold.title: Flag customers with this many returns to origin (0 = off)

rto_require_advance.title: Flagged customers pay the advance on pay-on-delivery orders
rto_require_advance.description: With no advance configured, their pay-on-delivery orders go to review instead.

phone_match_digits.title: Match phone numbers on their last N digits (0 = the whole number)
